children: WUHU, China, Sept. 07, 2026

-- On September 7, CHERY launches its TIGGO9 CSH product film featuring Robert Lewandowski, CHERY Brand Global Ambassador, across its global channels. Following the “CHERY. For Family” brand film, the new film brings the brand promise to life through the product experience. Featuring scenes from Lewandowski's training and daily travel, the film brings the legendary No. 9 together with TIGGO9 CSH—two "9s" united by a shared pursuit of performance, precision and continuous progress.
Legendary No. 9 Robert Lewandowski and TIGGO9 CSH
Watch the full film on CHERY’s official Facebook page:
Two No. 9s, One Pursuit of Excellence

As one of football's most iconic No. 9s, Lewandowski is known for his consistent performance, disciplined professionalism and relentless drive to improve. Sharing the same number as Lewandowski's iconic No. 9 jersey, TIGGO9 CSH reflects a similar pursuit of excellence through performance, comfort, safety and technology.

The connection between the two "9s" goes beyond the number itself. Built around Control, Precision and Consistency, the film explores a shared belief that excellence is found in every detail. For Lewandowski, performance begins before the first move—in reading the game, choosing the right moment and refining every detail. For TIGGO9 CSH, that same attention to detail translates into performance, handling, comfort and confidence on every journey.
From Technology t
o Everyday Experience

As a flagship model powered by CHERY Super Hybrid (CSH), TIGGO9 CSH is designed to meet not only the practical needs of family travel, but also growing expectations for greater comfort, efficiency and confidence on every journey. CSH technology combines strong performance with high efficiency, enabling TIGGO9 CSH to perform confidently in both daily urban driving and long-distance travel, while giving users greater flexibility in how they refuel or recharge.
TIGGO9 CSH

For families, a better journey also means greater comfort for every passenger. With a 2,800 mm wheelbase and flexible 5+2 seven-seat layout, TIGGO9 CSH offers generous, adaptable space for different family needs and travel scenarios. A quiet cabin and thoughtful comfort features help everyone stay relaxed, whether on daily drives or longer journeys. Meanwhile, a comprehensive vehicle protection system developed in line with global five-star safety standards, together with intelligent driver assistance technologies, helps provide greater confidence on every journey.

Travel freedom is about more than reaching the destination—it is about travelling on your own terms. True comfort is about more than space—it is about making every passenger feel considered. And true confidence comes not from specifications alone, but from knowing the family can enjoy every journey with greater ease. For TIGGO9 CSH, this is where technology becomes meaningful: when it delivers real value for families.
Bringing “For Family” into the Product Experience

The first "CHERY. For Family" brand film focused on the emotional meaning of protecting and supporting a family. The new product film brings that idea into the vehicle itself, showing how "For Family" comes to life through the vehicle’s capabilities. For CHERY, product strength is not defined by specifications alone, but by how technology responds to the needs of families in everyday life. When space, hybrid performance, safety and technology translate into greater comfort, confidence and freedom on the road, "For Family" becomes more than a brand promise—it becomes something families can experience on every journey.

With the global launch of the TIGGO9 CSH product film, the story of the two "9s" comes together in full. Excellence is found in every detail—and ultimately, the true value of technology lies in making every family journey more confident, comfortable and enjoyable.

Note: The product data mentioned in this article is based on CHERY’s dedicated testing. Actual performance may vary depending on road conditions, weather, driving style, vehicle configuration and usage environment.
